acceptance_criteria.criterion: `rest-api.md` contains the two new launch endpoints in a dedicated "Launch" section with correct HTTP methods, paths, success/error codes, and descriptions.
`api-surface.md` contains the `launchApplication()` function signature under a new section for `src/server/app-launcher.ts`.
`gui-frontend.md` reflects the new "Open in VS Code" button, the per-repo "Open" button / 4th "Actions" column, and the two new `api.workspaces` methods.
All documentation follows the existing formatting and style of each manifest document.

gui-frontend.md API Client section: already listed openVscode and openGithubDesktop in the api.workspaces summary line and in the 'Launch Methods' reference table — no changes required.
All edits follow the existing table formatting and style of each manifest document.

comments.note: rest-api.md: the two launch endpoints were already present but embedded in the Workspaces section. Moved to a standalone ## Launch section to satisfy the AC and improve discoverability.
